_note: Feature parity matrix (EDITION-RULES.md rule 3, MOBILE-UX-PLAN.md 6.4). Every key binding in the code (__sc.KEYMAP rows, id = where|keys) is listed under one capability's covers, or under ignoreKeys with a reason. Every control (button with an id) appears as a desktop.sel or phone.sel, or under ignoreControls with a reason. Each capability has a desktop and a phone side; a missing side needs desktopOnly / phoneOnly / desktopOmit / phoneOmit with a REASON. A phone side may be a selector, or a gesture (words). visible:true means the control must be visible on load (and 48 px or more on the phone).
